solutions.title: Separate DP table
solutions.strategy: Build a table whose cell stores the minimum path sum to that coordinate.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each of the m by n cells is computed once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The DP table mirrors the grid size.

solutions.title: In-place grid DP
solutions.strategy: Reuse the grid cells to store the minimum path sum to each coordinate.

spaceComplexity.explanation: No auxiliary table is allocated beyond the input grid storage.
